_comment: RAG Phase 1 source registry. Facts below were read from each publisher's public pages on 2026-10-28; reading a page is not permission to store, embed, adapt, translate or display its content. A source may be ingested only when its licence is verified and 'store' and 'embed' are both 'granted' with the written permission recorded under 'permission_evidence' (see app/core/knowledge.py). Not legal advice: have the licence and permission notes reviewed before Phase 3.

sources.title: Doing What Matters in Times of Stress: An Illustrated Guide
sources.format: PDF guide (who.int: 132 pages; IRIS record: 126 p.) with optional audio exercises; translations in many languages
topics: unhooking from difficult thoughts and feelings

licence.name: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO
licence.notes: IRIS citation states the licence. Non-commercial use needs no permission; adaptations and translations must carry WHO's disclaimer and the same or a similar licence; no endorsement, no WHO logo. The Urdu edition is published by the Human Development Research Foundation and needs its own licence check. The five skills are acceptance-based rather than classic CBT: the clinical advisor decides how to label them.

permission_evidence.granted_by: WHO, under the CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO licence, for non-commercial use; non-commercial use decided by the app owner (Hajira, HajiraAzfar)
permission_evidence.reference: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/igo/ and the IRIS record https://iris.who.int/handle/10665/331901; the owner's decision is recorded in DEVLOG.md (RAG: WHO cards)

sources.next_action: The 5 adapted cards were turned on by the app owner on 2026-10-29 for the FYP demo WITHOUT clinical review. A clinician should check them against the guide itself (wording and sections); record the reviewer on each card, or set it back to draft if anything is wrong. Add a licence/attribution note to the app's About screen.
sources.use_decision: Non-commercial: Reframe is a free student project with no ads or payments (owner, 2026-10-28). Conditions: credit WHO and the licence on every adapted card; say the adaptation was not created by WHO; share adaptations under the same licence; no WHO logo and no suggestion that WHO endorses the app. If the app becomes commercial, withdraw these grants and request WHO permission.
sources.attribution: Adapted from WHO, Doing What Matters in Times of Stress (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO); not created by WHO.
